findings.one_line: The proposal promised a universal-constant minimax frontier with a matching all-interval lower bound, but the delivered headline is only a constructive upper sandwich plus modulus/mask certificates and an explicit separation; retitle and position the contribution as that weaker, still substantive adaptive-sandwich result.

The claimed finite convex-program rule is not yet evaluable for an arbitrary outcome-adaptive known design: the objective contains a supremum over schedules and assignment-history expectations without a finite optimization formulation, representation requirement for the propensity maps, or evaluation algorithm.

Position the precise sandwich/separation theorem against each materially relevant bibliography entry, especially adaptive-experiment inference and NCC borrowing papers now only listed or mentioned generically, rather than relying on a broad non-transfer assertion.

DELETE this strictly weaker duplicate corollary: its fixed-radius and thresholded-mask displays are already implied by the sharp-mask headline and add no independently delivered result; retain the comparison in prose if useful.
DELETE this superseded weaker sandwich theorem and carry any historical two-point mask comparison as prose; the sharp-mask theorem is the only needed numbered headline.
